records.subject: Finance and Insurance
records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Adults Aged 15 Years And Above With An Account At A Financial Institution Or Mobile-Money-Service Provider By Sex
records.title: Proportion Of Adults Aged 15 Years And Above With An Account At A Financial Institution Or Mobile-Money-Service Provider By Sex, Triennial
records.footnote: Data are collected every 3 years. Surveying for 2020 was delayed to 2021 due to COVID-19 restrictions. Data are used for SDG 8.10.2 'Proportion of adults (15 years and older) with an account at a bank or other financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.10.2.
